Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent 2D orthogonal top-down game decoration sprite.
Create one grand folio book display occupying a WIDE 2-by-1 rectangular floor footprint for a sunset celestial sanctum. Two enormous open angular books on a shared low ivory-stone and brass display lectern, blue and copper covers, clean polygonal cream pages, one full width rectangular shallow plinth underneath. View from high above directly facing south: horizontal back and front edges, vertical depth edges; NOT isometric. The long ground footprint should read twice as wide as deep. Fill the full plinth width. Tall upright books can extend above back edge but base remains visible.
Style: thick crisp near-black navy silhouette outlines, simpler thinner interior lines, long straight segments, wedges, trapezoids, obvious corners. Flat crisp cel shading only, two or three tones per material. Ivory cream stone, ochre brass, copper rust accents, deep navy and cool blue books. Clean sharp graphic anime plus Western cartoon environment asset, same style across all surfaces.
Single isolated complete sprite on genuinely transparent alpha background. No ground shadow outside footprint, no people, no text or lettering, no labels/grid, no planetary spheres, no moon, no gradients, texture, grain, painterly/airbrush/3D, no rounded inflatable forms. Generous transparent margin; no cropping.

Fill square platform across full width AND full depth, not a thin horizontal bookshelf; no tall narrow cabinet. Many broad cream parchment planes and geometric brass rails. Square rectangular platform is the real footprint.
